## Highlights since 0.16.8

- **Know when your TeX packages are out of date.** Lattice tells you when your TeX packages are out of date and offers a one-click update.
- **Newer default model in the AI assistant.** "sonnet" and "haiku" now mean Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5, the default model is Sonnet 5.5, and Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.2 show their real default effort.

## Notable fixes

- In an Overleaf project, the PDF your build makes is no longer synced to or from Overleaf, so a collaborator's PDF can no longer replace yours when the main document sits in a subfolder (such as `cvpr/main.tex`). If the PDF is replaced anyway, Lattice rebuilds instead of showing someone else's PDF.
- Ctrl/⌘ + wheel zoom in the PDF keeps the point under the pointer instead of jumping to another page. Thanks to @Livioni.
- Drag-selecting text past the edge of the editor scrolls smoothly. Thanks to @wchen99998.
